##### Project general facts

Azizi Jewel by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building with modern architecture, where glass facades lend the building elegance and landscaped green areas create a comfortable urban setting. Clean lines and a balanced blend of style and functionality give the building a timeless character. It rises above two basement levels and a ground floor to seven residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one-bedroom apartments that combine the energy of city life with a calm atmosphere.

Residents enjoy a swimming pool with a children's pool, a modern gym and a children's play area for an active family routine. Spacious landscaped grounds with relaxation and recreation zones, a barbecue area and walking paths offer calm places to unwind, while cafes, restaurants and retail outlets add everyday convenience, complemented by a welcoming lobby, lifts, outdoor parking and round-the-clock security with video surveillance.

Interiors are finished with high-quality materials that enhance both durability and aesthetics, with thoughtful layouts and large windows that fill the living spaces with natural light. Compact, efficient floor plans suit young professionals, couples and investors seeking practical city homes. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances and built-in wardrobes, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is an established family-friendly community in western Dubai, known for its mix of villas, townhouses and low-rise apartment buildings in Arabic, Mediterranean and contemporary styles. Landscaped parks, playgrounds, sports courts, cycling and jogging tracks and community retail centres with cafes, supermarkets and clinics cover daily needs close to home and give the area a calm, green character.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Sheikh Zayed Road connect residents with the wider city, and the Al Furjan metro station is close by. Ibn Battuta Mall and the Jebel Ali Free Zone are a short drive away, Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence, Palm Jumeirah and Expo City Dubai are close by, and the Dubai International Financial Centre, Business Bay and Al Maktoum International Airport are within comfortable reach.

Al Furjan is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most popular addresses in western Dubai. Metro access, mature infrastructure and proximity to Dubai Marina and the Jebel Ali Free Zone attract young professionals and families, supporting high occupancy. Compact studios and one-bedroom homes at competitive prices underpin steady rental demand, attractive yields and long-term value for investors.
